issueType.description: The single best supported Civic Pack category, or UNKNOWN when evidence is insufficient or outside the catalogue.

subcategory.description: A short evidence-grounded subtype, or null. It must not name an authority, department, route, or filing channel.

description.description: A concise description grounded only in visible image evidence and supplied citizen text.

confidence.description: Internal certainty from 0 to 1 for the selected issueType.

detectedLanguage.description: Language of the citizen-supplied text; UNKNOWN when there is no usable text.

needsClarification.description: Exactly true when issueType is UNKNOWN or confidence is below 0.80; otherwise false.

clarificationQuestion.description: One short neutral question when needsClarification is true; otherwise null.
